localProbe.version: Baseline before the acceleration response candidate; retained for comparison. Running the command now measures the current implementation.
localProbe.fixture: Calm deep water, default tuning, ordinary full-throttle input; no obstacles or course-progress claim. Countdown retained. Compare held throttle against throttle pressed at GO for every rider.
localProbe.launchComparison: All samples are identical for both countdown inputs. Pressed-at-GO sets rocketStarted; held throttle does not. Current rocketStart only sets power=5, already the starting power in practice/stunt mode. No additional velocity or acceleration boost exists. This does not prove the original uses the same start implementation.

candidate.model: Multiply the existing net longitudinal engine response by 1 + throttle * (0.85 + 2.4 * speedRatioSquared). Wave intake, hull drag, brakes, rider ratings and checkpoint allowances remain active. No velocity jump or timed artificial boost.
candidate.rider: Mara Vale, default tuning, calm deep-water fixture
candidate.scope: Three-point acceleration fit, not proof of original physics or course parity. Earlier sixth-power resistance candidates changed partial-throttle cruising excessively and were replaced. Existing traversal checks remain mandatory.

nextCalibration: Recheck guided approaches and jump distances under the calibrated response, identify the reference rider/tuning or collect another known setup, then compare original route pace. The verification driver also targets approximately 13 m/s, well below the reference straight speed. Retain the observed 20/15/15/15 checkpoint allowances. Do not infer a uniform map scale from the timeout alone.
